import sys

def compute(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    base = 1
    count = 1
    while base * 10 + 1 < n:
        base = base * 10 + 1
        count += 1
    option1 = compute(n % base) + (n // base) * count
    option2 = compute(((base * 10 + 1) - n) % base) + count + 1 + (((base * 10 + 1) - n) // base) * count
    return min(option1, option2)

def run():
    number = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
    print(compute(number))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
